long_biography.plain_text:
Preston Holidays concentrates on ferry-based short breaks to Jersey, Guernsey, Alderney, Herm and Sark. Grant Dean Miller revived the brand after its previous group ceased trading, retaining a narrow Channel Islands focus instead of restoring the wider programme. That decision preserved an established specialist name within his broader travel business.

Miller also applies existing brands to digital publishing. He relaunched Daily Sport online after acquiring its name from administrators and later developed The Bet as a sports-wagering information portal. His current portfolio spans travel, publishing, promotions, technology and consumer products, with several active companies under his direct control.
